cases.prompt: A city wants to reduce small-business permit wait times while preserving safety review and public accountability. Generate meaningfully different approaches.
user_turns: Additional context: applicants repeat the same information across departments, while reviewers discover missing evidence late. Safety specialists are scarce and elected officials require an auditable decision trail.

Final context: the city can change sequencing, intake, triage, and information flow, but statutory reviews and public records must remain. Produce your final portfolio now using all available information.

cases.prompt: Users keep ignoring our medication reminder app. Give me fresh ideas that are not just more notifications, badges, or AI personalization.
